scope: Autonomous peer-local generation-zero text build/review over actual local TCP, private durable journals and a common authenticated lease/dispatch authority. Zero-provider fixture qualification; not coding quality or a four-cell causal study.

verification.scope: Targeted new authority/planner/work runtime qualification, not a whole-project rerun or quality study. Prior process run predates strengthened test assertions and is retained as development evidence.
verification.reconciliation_diagnostic: First inline reconciliation used the verifier JSON hash serializer for the scientific contract, causing an assertion despite identical contract content. Corrected to the scientific contract canonical digest; no source or tests changed and no tests repeated.

scenarios: Per-principal authenticated task allowlists, run/config/source binding and atomic lease/reservation/request receipts
Actual authority process death before/after durable intent and result commits, same-ID replay and epoch fencing
Autonomous builder and reviewer consume arrived local evidence only; reviewer cannot act through a bidirectional partition
Same local decision policy through actual gossip and healthy two-broker relay adapter
Worker death before result publication and after publication before local acknowledgment; one immutable output event
Lost completed authority acknowledgment recovers original receipt with one entry attempt per action
Unknown dispatch before or after entry retains full reservation and remains terminal through further worker ticks and restart
Authority outage preserves prepared intent and visible durable transport-error history; recovery clears pending error
Expired historical claim cannot grant a new dispatch; observer has no run_action, acceptance, release or settlement RPC

evidence_semantics.authority_entry_trace: An entry-attempt record is not proof that a fixture completed or a provider call occurred.
evidence_semantics.work_telemetry: Boots, RPC attempts/replies/errors and pending transport error persist across restart; a request attempt is not a commit.
evidence_semantics.publication: Idempotent exact outbox across two databases, not a cross-database atomic transaction.
evidence_semantics.timing: 18.778 seconds is development verification duration, not an approach latency comparison or model performance observation.

retained_development_evidence.detail: Central discovery rejected indirect unittest inheritance; corrected to direct TestCase declarations without inherited test methods. No test execution occurred.
Earlier fast development execution, not silently reused as final qualification.
Earlier process execution before strengthened unknown-after-entry and post-restart checks; preserved separately.

limits: Trusted host and gossip group, no isolation from malicious same-user peers or independent signatures on forwarded receipts.
Only one generation-zero action slot; no source selection, refutation, reopening or project completion.
Unknown dispatch is deliberately terminal and reserved; no automatic retry of invocation or peer-authorized settlement.
Permanent authority outage stays visibly pending; no overall live deadline or retry backoff yet.
Base transport byte counters remain per-boot; work RPC telemetry is durable but does not establish total network cost.
Application transport gates and local process deaths do not establish WAN, host-loss or multi-host behavior.
No model-quality, orchestration superiority, independent held-out confirmation or Elo claim follows from these fixture checks.
Static verification covers configured roots and retains117 exact historical diagnostics; not all legacy dynamic code is proven type-safe.
